Tomato Early Blight: Remove infected leaves, avoid overhead irrigation, and apply recommended fungicide.
Tomato Late Blight: Use copper-based fungicide, remove infected plants, and maintain proper spacing.
Tomato Leaf Mold: Improve air circulation and reduce humidity around plants.
Potato Early Blight: Use disease-resistant seeds and apply fungicide treatment.
Potato Late Blight: Remove infected plants immediately and apply copper fungicide.
Rice Blast: Use resistant varieties, maintain balanced fertilizer and apply fungicide.
Rice Brown Spot: Improve soil nutrients and apply suitable fungicide.
Wheat Rust: Apply fungicide and use rust-resistant wheat varieties.
Corn Leaf Blight: Remove infected leaves and apply recommended fungicide.
Apple Scab: Remove infected leaves and apply fungicide spray.
Grape Powdery Mildew: Maintain proper airflow and apply sulfur-based treatment.
Healthy: Plant is healthy. Continue proper irrigation, nutrition, and monitoring.
